SEAT RE | status: BLOCKED (IDB incident, read this before assigning more RE)
did: While switching from the ida MCP to idalib (the ida tools were removed from the Code Mode catalog mid-session), I opened the shared IDB from a second process with run_auto_analysis=False and the close persisted a database without its function records. Reporting it plainly because every seat's RE depends on this file.
evidence: D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag\AC4BFSP.exe, unpacked DB (.id0/.id1/.id2/.nam/.til). Function records: 128,610 before -> 964 now. Everything else is INTACT: instruction bytes, names, comments. sub_54EC00 is still named; ida_funcs.add_func(0x54EC00) returns True in 0.01s and restores the exact original bounds 0x54ec00..0x54ec1f, and Hex-Rays then decompiles it correctly. So the loss is the function list only, not the analysis.
recovery, all verified in this session: (1) open the exe with idalib; (2) call ida_funcs.add_func(addr) for every addr in RE-AC4/symbols/functions.jsonl and functions_v2.jsonl (33,760 addresses, ~0.01s each) - this restores every NAMED function with its original bounds; (3) for the remaining ~95k unnamed functions, let one auto-analysis run to completion and save. Do NOT open the DB from two processes at once and do NOT call close_database after a no-analysis open.
safety net: copy of the current damaged files at C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\idbbak (id0/id1/id2/nam/til).
next: run the guarded restore in one clean session (no other IDA process alive), then tell me and I resume T20.
blocked-by: nothing - needs one clean run by whoever owns the IDB
